terms.label: SNOMED CT Concept
terms.definition: Root concept for the SNOMED CT hierarchy.

terms.label: Clinical finding
terms.definition: A finding that can be observed clinically.

terms.label: Disease
terms.definition: A disorder with a specific pathological process.

terms.label: Diabetes mellitus
terms.definition: A disorder of glucose metabolism characterized by hyperglycemia.

terms.label: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
terms.definition: Type 2 diabetes mellitus clinical disorder.

terms.label: Type 1 diabetes mellitus
terms.definition: Type 1 diabetes mellitus due to autoimmune destruction of pancreatic beta cells.

terms.label: Asthma
terms.definition: A chronic inflammatory disorder of the airways.

terms.label: Hypertensive disorder
terms.definition: Persistently high arterial blood pressure.

terms.label: Disorder of cardiovascular system
terms.definition: A disease affecting the heart or blood vessels.

terms.label: Coronary arteriosclerosis
terms.definition: Narrowing of the coronary arteries due to atherosclerosis.

terms.label: Myocardial infarction
terms.definition: Necrosis of the myocardium due to interrupted blood supply.

terms.label: Disorder of respiratory system
terms.definition: A disease affecting the respiratory tract or lungs.

terms.label: Chronic obstructive lung disease
terms.definition: A chronic inflammatory lung disease causing obstructed airflow.

terms.label: Infectious disease
terms.definition: A disease caused by pathogenic microorganisms.

terms.label: Pneumonia
terms.definition: Inflammation of the lung parenchyma caused by infection.

terms.label: Neoplasm
terms.definition: An abnormal mass of tissue resulting from abnormal cell proliferation.

terms.label: Malignant neoplasm of breast
terms.definition: Cancer arising from breast tissue.

terms.label: Carcinoma of lung
terms.definition: Malignant tumor arising from lung epithelial tissue.

terms.label: Procedure
terms.definition: An activity performed for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes.

terms.label: Surgical procedure
terms.definition: A procedure involving operative manual and instrumental techniques.
